name: Deadly Smile
source:
Facing your past, it is now your job to uncover a beastly serial killer - before it is too late.

Ten years ago, there was a murder where the victim had their hands removed, their blood drained, and only a single, chilling clue - a deadly smile. 

People tried to cover it up and move on. Now however, bodies are turning up in the exact same pattern. As Marko, an investigative reporter who is forced back into the fray, you will chase the truth alongside Laura, the wannabe detective with a gun that defies all logic, and Dee your ever "reliable" assistant. Together you will piece together cases a decade in the making, and race to find the killer before it's too late.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5086740/Deadly_Smile/]Steam[/url]]
